newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-ESTONIA V SCOTLAND TEAMS FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ESTONIA V SCOTLAND TEAMS FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup European group four qualifying match between Estonia and Scotland on Tuesday:
Estonia - 1-Mart Poom, 6-Viktor Alonen, 4-Sergei Hohlov-Simson, 14-Urmas Kirs, 9-Marko Kristal, 8-Liivo Leetma, 2-Marek Lemsalu, 10-Martin Reim, 7-Meelis Rooba, 3-Urmas Rooba, 5-Indrek Zelinski.

Scotland - 1-Andy Goram, 2-Jackie McNamara, 3-Tommy Boyd, 4-Colin Calderwood, 5-Colin Hendry, 11-John McGinlay, 6-Kevin Gallacher, 8-Paul McStay, 9-Duncan Ferguson, 10-Gary McAllister, 7-John Collins.
